annotations.title: Contribute price data in a batch

description: Share up to 100 observed prices with the data exchange in one call, 10 tokens for each one accepted. Each item is the same data point contribute_price_data takes. The data joins the shared pool other workspaces can read, so send only public prices. An item that repeats a source, product and price from the last 24 hours is reported as a duplicate, earns nothing and does not stop the rest. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

contributions.description: One to 100 data points, each as contribute_price_data takes it.

currency.description: The currency code. Defaults to USD.

metadata.description: Any extra detail to keep with the data point.

plan_name.description: The plan tier, when the product has several.

price.description: The price seen, in currency units.

product_name.description: The product or plan the price is for.

scraped_at.description: When the price was seen, as an ISO 8601 date-time. Defaults to now.

source_url.description: The public page the price was seen on.

vertical.description: The market the price belongs to, for example saas.

name: contribute_price_data_batch
